items.title: Russian strike hits critical infrastructure in Kyiv, threatening power and water disruptions
items.teaser: In Kyiv, the Russians have struck a critical infrastructure facility; there may be disruptions to electricity and water supplies.

items.title: Such- und Rettungarbeiten in Slowjansk nach russischem Luftangriff abgeschlossen: Leichen von 10 Toten aus Trümmern geborgen
items.teaser: In der Stadt Slowjansk in der Region Donezk sind Such- und Rettungarbeiten nach einem russischen Luftangriff am 22. November abgeschlossen worden. Aus den Trümmern eines zerstörten Wohnhauses wurden die Leichen von 10 Toten geborgen, darunter ein Kind.

items.title: Drones attack Kremenchuk, damage industrial facility, residential buildings
items.teaser: Russian drones have attacked Kremenchuk in the Poltava region, damaging an industrial facility, residential buildings and an outbuilding.

items.title: Ukraine's expertise comes in handy for international drone alliances
items.teaser: Ukrainian expertise merged with Europe's financial and industrial clout: Germany and other countries are expanding drone partnerships with Ukraine and reshaping Europe's defense industry in the process.

items.title: Russen töten vier und verletzen acht Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Die russische Armee hat in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, am 27. November, vier Einwohner der Region Donezk getötet.

items.title: Russians sentence Colombian POW who fought for Ukraine to 20 years in prison
items.teaser: A Russian-controlled court in occupied Donetsk has sentenced 33-year-old Colombian POW Cristian Morales Mendoza, who fought for Ukraine, to 20 years in prison.

items.title: Italian PM was furious during call with Zelenskyy about attack near Libya
items.teaser: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni was reportedly furious with Volodymyr Zelenskyy because Ukraine did not notify its allies before attacking Russian ships near Libya.

items.title: Flugverkehr am Airport Köln/Bonn nach Drohnensichtung zeitweise gestoppt
items.teaser: Am Airport Köln/Bonn ist am späten Abend der Flugverkehr vorübergehend eingestellt worden. Anlass war eine gesichtete Drohne. Warum sie dort unterwegs war, ist unklar. Mittlerweile können die Flugzeuge wieder starten und landen.

items.title: Russian forces attack two apartment buildings in Kharkiv with drones, one injured
items.teaser: Russian invaders have struck an apartment building in the Saltivskyi district and a nine-story residential building in the Kyivskyi district of Kharkiv with drones.

items.title: Hungary reportedly lifts entry ban on Ukraine's drone forces commander
items.teaser: The ban, which also applied across the Schengen Area, was imposed in August 2025 by then-Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto after Ukraine struck the Druzhba oil pipeline, through which Hungary received Russian oil.

items.title: Datenleak zeigt Ausmaß russischer Verluste im Krieg gegen die Ukraine
items.teaser: Russland hält die offiziellen Zahlen zu seinen Verlusten im Ukraine-Krieg unter Verschluss. Nun liefert ein Hackerangriff auf die Statistikbehörde Einblicke - und gibt Hinweise auf Hunderttausende getötete russische Soldaten. Von L. Becker.

items.title: Ukraine honours victims of Holodomor on Remembrance Day
items.teaser: Ukrainians are urged to join a nationwide minute of silence and light a candle in their windows at 16:00 on Holodomor Remembrance Day, which falls on 28 November this year.

items.title: Six-day search operation in Sloviansk concludes, ten bodies recovered from rubble
items.teaser: Emergency rescue operations have been completed in Sloviansk following a Russian airstrike on November 22. Rescuers recovered the bodies of ten people, including a child, from the rubble.

items.title: Critical infrastructure facility hit in Kyiv, mayor reports possible power and water supply disruptions
items.teaser: A Russian drone attack has damaged a critical infrastructure facility in Kyiv, with some districts at risk of electricity and water supply disruptions.

items.title: Two injured in Russian drone strike on nine-storey apartment building in Kharkiv
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck a nine-storey apartment building in the Kyivskyi district of Kharkiv on the afternoon of 28 November, injuring two women.

items.title: Airport in western Germany suspends operations for several hours after drone spotted
items.teaser: Cologne Bonn Airport in western Germany suspended operations for several hours on the evening of November 27 after a drone was spotted near the airport.

items.title: Ukraine verleiht erstmals den Filmpreis Free World Award – Bird of Freedom from Ukraine
items.teaser: Im Rahmen des 30. Tallinn Black Nights Film Festivals (PÖFF) in Tallinn hat die Ukraine zum ersten Mal den jährlichen Preis Free World Award – Bird of Freedom from Ukraine („Preis der Freien Welt – Vogel der Freiheit aus der Ukraine“) verliehen.

items.title: German and Ukrainian companies plan to develop seeker head for Neptune missile
items.teaser: A German arms manufacturer and a Ukrainian company plan to jointly develop a seeker head for the Neptune cruise missile as part of expanded defence cooperation.

items.title: Ukraine commemorates victims of Holodomor famine
items.teaser: Ukraine experienced three major famines in the 20th century: in 1921-1923, 1932-1933, and 1946-1947. The 1932-1933 famine was the deadliest and has been recognized as a genocide of the Ukrainian people.

items.title: Ukraine calls for US envoy Kushner to be removed from peace talks, Politico says
items.teaser: Ukrainian politicians and European allies criticise Jared Kushner over his comments on Putin and the war, calling for him to be removed from peace negotiations.

items.title: Russian forces attack railway infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, fires break out
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked railway infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region on the evening of November 27, setting administrative buildings in Korosten on fire.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1738: Germany, EU, and Hungary move on Ukraine’s support
items.teaser: Berlin locks in €11.6 billion for Ukraine's defense while the EU's €45 billion loan slips to December.

items.title: Russian attacks injure 23 civilians in Kharkiv region over past day
items.teaser: Twenty-three civilians, including three children, were injured in Russian attacks in the Kharkiv region on Friday, November 27.

items.title: Zweiter Angriff binnen einer Woche: Drohnen treffen Ölanlagen in Nowoschachtinsk und Samara
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 28. November haben Drohnen einige Ölanlagen in Russland angegriffen.

items.title: Russians kill last resident of Tiahynka in Kherson Oblast
items.teaser: The remains of the last resident of the village of Tiahynka in Kherson Oblast have been found. Local authorities say the man was killed by Russian soldiers.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly launches massive attack on Moscow Oblast with 460 drones
items.teaser: The reported Ukrainian attack prompted flight restrictions at several airports, including Vnukovo and Domodedovo in Moscow Oblast.

items.title: Hacks und Spionage: Wie sicher ist die Forschung in Deutschland?
items.teaser: Russland, China, USA und Iran – die Weltpolitik fordert auch die Wissenschaft heraus. Wie geht Wissenschaft, wenn Forschende Spionage und Technologieabfluss mitdenken müssen?

items.teaser: Am 27. November kam es zu 146 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front. Am heftigsten umkämpft bleiben die Abschnitte Kostjantyniwka und Huljaipole.

items.title: Three injured and energy infrastructure facility damaged in Russian attack on Kyiv Oblast

items.title: Emergency power cuts introduced in Kyiv Oblast due to Russian attacks and overloaded equipment
items.teaser: Emergency outages have been imposed across Kyiv Oblast due to damage from Russian attacks and overloaded equipment; repair crews are working to restore electricity supply.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 10, injure 55 across Ukraine over past day as deadly strike hits Chernihiv Oblast businesses
items.teaser: Alongside the attacks on Chernihiv Oblast, Russian forces launched 162 drones at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 28, including 74 jet-powered ones, the Air Force reported.

items.title: Two women injured in Russian attacks on Sumy region over past day

items.teaser: The Russian army killed four residents of the Donetsk region on November 27, while eight other civilians were injured.

items.title: Number of people injured in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast rises, child among them

items.teaser: Zaporizhzhia Oblast Police and animal welfare volunteers have evacuated resident Iryna and the abandoned pets she cared for from Balabyne under anti-drone cover amid intensifying Russian attacks, with the animals set to be transported to Chernivtsi.

items.title: Starshield speed restrictions apply only to Russian-occupied territories, hamper Ukraine's middle strike campaign, military sources say
items.teaser: The restrictions, first introduced in October, have added to tensions between Kyiv and Washington over U.S. military and political support for Ukraine, while undermining Ukraine's ability to both strike Russian targets and defend against aerial attacks.

items.title: Ukrainian foreign minister warns Europe against delaying aid for Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has cautioned Europe against delaying military and macro-financial support, calling aid to Ukraine a matter of European self-preservation needed to match Russia's rising war budget.

items.title: Putin waging diplomatic aggression against the West – Czech opposition leader
items.teaser: Supporting Ukraine is important for the Czech Republic and the whole of Europe, as Putin is resorting to diplomatic aggression through his blatant demands and will not stop there.

items.title: Romania calls on NATO to help repel Russian hybrid attacks
items.teaser: Romanian Foreign Minister Dan Neculăescu has called on NATO to adopt joint measures against Russian hybrid threats – including cyberattacks, disinformation and Black Sea incidents – and warned that the Black Sea is becoming a weak spot in European security.

items.title: Russian attack on Pisochyn in Kharkiv region leaves eight injured, including three children
items.teaser: Eight people, including three children, were injured in a Russian attack on Pisochyn in the Kharkiv region.

items.title: Russia attacks Dnipropetrovsk Oblast over 20 times: one woman injured
items.teaser: According to regional head Oleksandr Hanzha, on 27 November Russian forces attacked Dnipro alongside the Pavlohrad, Synelnykove and Nikopol districts more than 20 times, damaging infrastructure and leaving a 74-year-old woman in a serious condition.

items.title: Ukraine's AI workforce grows 18%, but experienced engineers remain scarce, study shows
items.teaser: Some 79% of vacancies required experience with infrastructure and MLOps — the systems and processes used to deploy and maintain AI models. Yet only 19% of surveyed specialists rated their skills in this area highly, according to the study.

items.title: Ukraine hit oil, military facilities across 11 Russian regions over past week, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "Ukraine responds to every Russian strike absolutely justly," President Volodymyr Zelensky said. "Russia has been offered numerous options for de-escalation and ending this war, yet it has chosen war anyway."

items.title: Ukraine-Hilfen: Ronzheimer und AfD-Mann geraten aneinander
items.teaser: Hitzige Debatte zwischen Paul Ronzheimer und Markus Frohnmaier: In der phoenix runde geraten der Journalist und der AfD-Mann aneinander. Kern der Debatte: Hilfen für die Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian forces thwart Russian advance attempts, destroy armor before it reaches front lines
items.teaser: Russian troops are making sporadic attempts to advance using armored vehicles in the operational zone of the Operational Task Force South, but Ukrainian defenders are detecting and destroying the vehicles while they are still en route to their intended positions.

items.title: Generalstab bestätigt Angriff auf Produktionsstätte für Raketentreibstoff in der russischen Region Tula
items.teaser: Die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben gemeinsam mit der Widerstandsbewegung "Tschornaja Iskra" ("Schwarzer Funke") in der Nacht auf den 27. November das Werk für synthetischen Kautschuk in Jefremow in der russischen Region Tula angegriffen, das an der Herstellung von Treibstoff für den Abschuss von Iskander-Raketen

items.title: Putin und sein Schattenkrieg: Forscher warnen vor verheerendem Anschlag
items.teaser: Russische Sabotage in Europa nimmt an Schärfe zu. Besonders Verkehrswege geraten ins Visier, der Ernstfall rückt näher.

items.title: Russia uses memes to hit Canadians where it hurts after brutal wildfires. One shows their prime minister throwing cash at Zelenskyy, expert says
items.teaser: Russia doesn't invent Canada's problems, the disinformation expert believes.

items.title: Eight injured, including children, in Russian attack on village near Kharkiv
items.teaser: Oleh Syniehubov has reported that eight people, including three children, sustained injuries on 27 November when Russian forces struck the Kharkiv suburb of Pisochyn.

items.title: German Rheinmetall may scrap launch of ammunition plant in Ukraine
items.teaser: Rheinmetall CEO Armin Papperger has said during a Capital Markets Day presentation in Hamburg that the German defence group is considering shelving plans to build an artillery ammunition plant in Ukraine due to slow progress and Kyiv's domestic production push.

items.title: Nach Terrorplänen in Köln: Bericht: Islamisten hatten auch Synagoge in Malmö im Visier
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft ist einer proiranischen Terrorzelle auf der Spur, die einen Anschlag auf die Kölner Synagoge geplant haben soll. Nach der Festnahme zweier Iraker gehen Ermittler davon aus, dass auch die Synagoge im schwedischen Malmö auf der Zielliste gestanden hat.

items.title: Fake accounts impersonate Kyiv Independent journalist to solicit footage of Russian attacks
items.teaser: Fraudulent accounts sought to impersonate Olesia Bida, a journalist with the Kyiv Independent’s War Crimes Unit, by contacting photographers and media outlets to request photos and videos documenting the aftermath of Russian attacks.

items.title: General Staff confirms strike on Tula factory producing fuel for Iskander missiles
items.teaser: On the night of 27 November, the Ukrainian Defence Forces, in coordination with the ‘Chernaya Iskra’ insurgent movement, struck the Yefremov synthetic rubber plant in the Tula Region of the Russian Federation, which is involved in the production of solid rocket fuel, in particular for ‘Iskander’ ballistic missiles.

items.title: Divisions deepen between EU member states after tense budget summit
items.teaser: An EU leaders summit on the bloc's seven-year budget fell apart amid divisions over how to fund Ukraine. The budget proposal also includes a 3% tax on US tech companies, in a bid for the EU to generate additional funds.

items.title: Lifelong gamer gets real Ukraine’s Vampire bomber drone. Once UN children’s agency worker, he now hits Russian targets along border
items.teaser: "I had no idea what a Vampire was," he recalls.

items.title: Ukraine destroys concealed Russian army oil depot in Operation Hell-3
items.teaser: The SxLüd unit of the 1st Corps of the National Guard’s ‘Azov’ and the Signum battalion of the 59th Separate Assault Brigade of Unmanned Systems of the 9th Army Corps destroyed a Russian invaders’ oil depot hidden in the forest as part of Operation ‘Hell-3’.

items.title: What Ukraine’s FPV footage doesn’t show: psychology of killing
items.teaser: The Kyiv Independent’s Nick Allard and Asami Terajima speak with Ukrainian drone operators about what it means to kill enemy soldiers through a screen.

items.title: Bulgaria holding EU's 22nd Russia sanctions package hostage in bid to extract concessions
items.teaser: Bulgaria's push to have the EU allow Russian iron imports to resume comes as Moscow does everything in its power to limit a competitor closer to home from being able to help — Ukraine.

items.title: Neun weitere Kinder aus besetzten Gebieten unter Vermittlung von Melania Trump in die Ukraine zurückgebracht
items.teaser: Neun weitere Kinder aus den vorübergehend besetzten Gebieten sind unter Vermittlung von Melania Trump in die Ukraine zurückgebracht worden, schreibt der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook.

items.title: Germany adopts 2027 budget with record borrowing, including €12bn in aid for Ukraine
items.teaser: German lawmakers have backed the 2027 budget by 317 votes to 260, approving €12 billion in aid for Ukraine, record €210 billion in borrowing and nearly €140 billion for defence.

items.title: Terrorverdächtiger Ameer J. hätte abgeschoben werden müssen
items.teaser: Einer der mutmaßlichen Terroristen, die Anschläge auf die Kölner Synagoge und weitere jüdische Einrichtungen geplant haben sollen, hätte längst abgeschoben werden können. FOCUS online rekonstruiert die Vorgeschichte.

items.title: In Köln geduldet gelebt: Festgenommener Iraker seit zwei Jahren ausreisepflichtig
items.teaser: Einer der beiden am Donnerstag unter dem Verdacht der Mitgliedschaft in einer terroristischen Gruppe festgenommenen Iraker ist einem Medienbericht zufolge schon seit zwei Jahren ausreisepflichtig gewesen.

items.title: Ukraine's Azov announces 'Hell-3' operation, destroys Russian fuel depot in occupied Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces had concealed the fuel depot and attempted to protect it with camouflage, electronic warfare systems and mobile fire groups, but the Ukrainian units managed to destroy both the storage site and its supporting logistics infrastructure, Azov said.

items.title: Zelensky chairs meeting on Kyiv situation attended by Klitschko
items.teaser: During a meeting of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief’s Headquarters of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, the logistics situation in Kyiv was discussed in the event of a significant deterioration of the situation due to Russian strikes. Among the speakers was the capital’s mayor, Vitali Klitschko.

items.title: Poland warns of anti-Ukrainian fake news regarding Ukrainian man who set himself on fire in Warsaw
items.teaser: Warsaw police spokesperson Jakub Pacyniak warned on 27 November that false claims, fake farewell letters and conspiracy theories are circulating online to incite anti-Ukrainian sentiment after a 22-year-old Ukrainian man set himself on fire outside the Presidential Palace.

items.title: Spox Pletenchuk: Russia seeks alternative supply routes for troops after partial collapse of Kerch Bridge
items.teaser: Following the damage to the Kerch Bridge, the Russian Federation is unable to fully supply Crimea with everything required by the Russian occupying forces; however, they will attempt to route more supplies overland.

items.title: Reparaturteam von Stromnetzbetreiber in Saporischschja gerät unter russischen Beschuss
items.teaser: Techniker des Betreibers des Stromnetzes in der Region Saporischschja sind während der Wiederherstellung der Stromversorgung unter Beschuss geraten. Das ist bereits der vierte Vorfall in diesem Monat.

items.title: Was Kiew mit Angriffen auf russische Schiffe erreichen will
items.teaser: Die Ukraine hat zuletzt russische Schiffe fernab der eigenen Grenzen vor Finnland und Libyen angegriffen. Militärexperte Gressel erklärt, wie diese Angriffe einzuschätzen sind.

items.title: Ukraine brings back 11 people from occupation and Russia, including children and deported Oleshky care home resident – photos
items.teaser: Ukraine has brought back nine children from occupied Kherson, Zaporizhzhia and Crimea alongside two women, including deported Oleshky care home resident Anastasiia Mamotiuk, bringing repatriations assisted by Melania Trump to 40.

items.title: Russia developing new satellite communications system for military use, HUR says
items.teaser: Innosat is a new low-Earth-orbit satellite project developed by St. Petersburg-based Geoscan as part of Russia's 10-year plan to deploy 240 satellites by 2036.

items.title: Ukrainian woman seeks love on Telegram and finds a handler instead. He gave her a task against a former border guard
items.teaser: Investigators have not said who the handler works for and are checking whether she worked for Russian intelligence.

items.title: Die internationalen Drohnen-Allianzen der Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainisches Know-how trifft auf Europas finanzielle und industrielle Stärke: Deutschland und andere Partner bauen ihre Drohnenproduktion mit der Ukraine aus. Das verändert auch Europas Rüstungsindustrie.

items.title: FM Sybiha: Russia seeks to include oil exports in Black Sea agricultural truce deal
items.teaser: Ukraine is proposing that the ceasefire agreements in the Black Sea focus on the safety of maritime navigation and the transport of agricultural produce, whilst Russia is attempting to include the issue of oil exports in them.

items.title: Ukraine strike plant critical to Russia's Iskander missile programme
items.teaser: Ukraine's Special Operations Forces working with the Chornaya Iskra insurgent movement have struck the Yefremov Synthetic Rubber Plant in Russia's Tula Oblast overnight on 26-27 November, hitting a key producer of Iskander rocket propellant components.

items.title: Italy denies that Zelenskyy coordinated attack on Russian ship in Libya with partners
items.teaser: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani denies that Ukraine coordinated its operation against a Russian ship in Libya with international partners.

items.title: Sicherheit - "Spiegel": Proiranische Gruppe plante auch Anschlag auf Synagoge in Schweden
items.teaser: Im Fall der mutmaßlichen Terrorgruppe, die einen Anschlag auf eine Kölner Synagoge geplant haben soll, gibt es offenbar auch eine Spur nach Schweden.

items.title: Bundesgerichtshof - Früherer BND-Chef Hanning scheitert mit Haftbeschwerde
items.teaser: Der unter Spionageverdacht stehende frühere BND-Präsident Hanning ist erfolglos gegen seine Untersuchungshaft vorgegangen.

items.title: Croatian court overturns extradition ruling against Ukrainian suspect in Nord Stream sabotage case
items.teaser: The law firm representing Volodymyr Zhuravliov said Croatia's High Criminal Court returned the case to the lower court for reconsideration.

items.title: Russen greifen Infrastruktur in Sumy und Schytomyr an: ein Mensch getötet und zwei weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff auf ein ziviles Unternehmen in der Gemeinde Malyn ist eine Person ums Leben gekommen. Zwei weitere Personen wurden verletzt, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Vitalij Bunetschko, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Zelenskyy wants strikes to further disrupt Russian military production
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine has adjusted its long-range operational plan to further slow Russian military production and certain economic processes.

items.title: Russian forces prepare for winter and new landings on Kherson’s Karantynny Island, Pivden reports
items.teaser: Russian troops in the Kherson region are attempting to prepare for winter conditions, despite logistical difficulties, and remain determined to land in the area of the Korabel neighbourhood on Karantynnyi Island in Kherson.

items.title: Selenskyj zu Ergebnissen ukrainischer Langstreckenangriffe: Ölanlagen, Rüstungsbetriebe und Militärflugplätze in Russland innerhalb einer Woche getroffen
items.teaser: Diese Woche haben die Verteidigungskräfte russische Ölanlagen, Rüstungsweke sowie Militärflugplätze und Flugzeuge getroffen.

items.title: Spionageverdacht: Ex-BND-Chef Hanning bleibt in Untersuchungshaft
items.teaser: Die Festnahme des Ex-BND-Chefs Hanning hatte im Oktober international Schlagzeilen produziert. Nun steht fest, dass der 80-Jährige vorerst in Haft bleibt. Gegen Hanning wird unter anderem wegen Spionageverdachts ermittelt.

items.title: 9 Ukrainian children returned from Russian-occupied territories, Russia through Melania Trump's mediation, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said the children were brought back from Russian-occupied Crimea, as well as parts of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts.

items.title: Ukraine stops electricity exports as Russian attacks strain power grid
items.teaser: The shift highlights how damage to the electricity grid can leave Ukraine The shift shows the impact of Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy grid, as the country increasingly relies on imports to meet domestic needs while losing export revenue for Ukrainian producers.

items.title: An Abridged Tale of Tuvalu: State Continuity, De-Recognition, and Digital Sovereignty as Responses to Sea-Level Rise
items.teaser: On 24 September 2026, the United Nations (‘UN’) General Assembly approved by consensus the first UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise, affirming “the presumption in favour of continued statehood” vis-à-vis states threatened with deterritorialization on account of sea-level rise; the most vulnerable being low-lying island s

items.title: Power engineers come under fire in Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: A Zaporizhzhiaoblenergo crew came under fire whilst restoring the electricity supply. This is the fourth such incident in the last month.

items.title: Russland greift Unternehmen in Nischyn an: es gibt zwei Tote und vier Verletzte
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben eines der Unternehmen in der Stadt Nischyn in der Region Tschernihiw angegriffen. Ein Mann und eine Frau sind getötet worden. Vier weitere Personen wurden verletzt.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Kremenchuk injures two
items.teaser: In Kremenchuk, in the Poltava region, a 55-year-old woman and a 17-year-old girl were injured as a result of Russian shelling.

items.title: Russian forces attack Lozova with jet-powered drones, injuring two people
items.teaser: Russian forces struck Lozova in Kharkiv Oblast with jet-powered drones on 27 November, injuring two people and sparking fires at a house and warehouse.

items.title: A Ukrainian Christmas music playlist from Euromaidan Press (2026 edition)
items.teaser: Try something new this holiday season with this selected collection of ancient and modern songs

items.title: Some Quick Reactions to USTR's Section 301 Excess Capacity Reports
items.teaser: On the day before Thanksgiving, USTR issued 14 separate reports related to its Section 301 investigation on "structural excess capacity and production in manufacturing sectors."
items.source: Int. Economic Law and Policy Blog

items.title: Under its new prime minister, Hungary just joined the push to bring back children Russia abducted—a step it never took under former leader Viktor Orbán
items.teaser: The change of government in Budapest is now showing up in concrete steps toward Kyiv, and this one closes the coalition's last EU gap.

items.title: Heraskewytsch begrüßt EU-Vorstoß gegen Athleten aus Russland
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Skeletonfahrer Wladyslaw Heraskewytsch hat Pläne der Europäischen Union begrüßt, russische Sportler bei Wettkämpfen innerhalb der EU stärker einzuschränken.

items.title: Russischen Kommandeuren droht man mit Sturmeinsatz wegen mangelnden Vormarsches in Richtung Saporischschja
items.teaser: Das Oberkommando der russischen Streitkräfte droht, Kommandeure in den Sturm wegen mangelnden Vormarsches in Richtung Saporischschja zu schicken.

items.title: Russians attack civilian business in Zhytomyr Oblast: one killed, two injured
items.teaser: One person was killed and two were injured in a Russian strike on a civilian business in Zhytomyr Oblast's Malyn hromada on the afternoon of 27 November.

items.title: Russian strike hits infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, leaving people injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an infrastructure facility in the Malyn community of the Zhytomyr region.

items.title: EU leaders push Ukraine’s €45 billion loan to December as three of 27 states hold out. Germany’s Merz ties the bloc’s budget to it
items.teaser: Slovakia offers diesel and excavators instead of cash, while even with the loan Ukraine would still be €25 billion short for 2027.

items.title: "They were trying to build their lives": IT couple killed in Russian drone attack on Kharkiv
items.teaser: A Russian Shahed drone hit a 15th-floor flat in Kharkiv on 26 November, killing 38-year-old IT specialists Daria and Valerii along with their cat.

items.title: Von einer chinesischen Fabrikstadt zum Nvidia-Skandal: Der Aufstieg von Alice Huang
items.teaser: Alice Huang verließ eine chinesische Waffenstadt und stieg zur Tech-Managerin auf. Nun belasten schwere Spionagevorwürfe ihr milliardenschweres Chipgeschäft.

items.title: Selenskyj vor schwierigem Winter: Wir werden Hauptstadt mit allen Mitteln verteidigen
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte in einem Interview mit BBC, das Ziel der Russen sei es, die Menschen zur Flucht aus den Städten, insbesondere aus Kyjiw, zu zwingen. Er versicherte jedoch, die Verteidigungskräfte würden die Stadt mit allen Mitteln verteidigen. Laut dem ukrainischen Präsidenten gäbe es kein Land o

items.title: Kontrolle des Verfassungsschutzes: AfD muss wohl draußen bleiben
items.teaser: Die Regierungsfraktionen in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern wollen bei der anstehenden Neuwahl der Kontrollkommission AfD-Vertreter nicht "durchwinken".

items.title: One Russian convoy reached Libya and lost its escort to Ukrainian drones—the next one turned around, OSINT researchers find
items.teaser: The second group of sanctioned cargo ships had crawled off the Tunisian coast for days before a radar satellite spotted it sailing back west.

items.title: Belarus says Ukraine and Russia have exchanged civilians at its border
items.teaser: Forty-three people crossed the Belarusian-Ukrainian border in a civilian exchange between Ukraine and Russia, with 23 arriving in Ukraine and 20 leaving.

items.title: Ukrainian border guards reporting no unusual incidents or provocations from Belarus – SBGS spox
items.teaser: Ukrainian border guards are not observing any enemy activity near the country’s border with Belarus.

items.title: Ukraine's Heraskevych hails EU pushback against Russian athletes
items.teaser: As European countries challenge Russia's sporting return, Ukrainian Olympian Vladyslav Heraskevych believes the IOC is facing a 'very big crisis.'

items.title: Russia extends ban on jet fuel exports amid Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries
items.teaser: Russia has extended restrictions on jet fuel exports until 31 March 2027 as a result of Ukrainian drone attacks targeting the country's oil refining facilities.

items.title: Russia sports ban: Ukraine's Heraskevych hails EU pushback
items.teaser: As European countries challenge Russia's sporting return, Ukrainian Olympian Vladyslav Heraskevych believes the IOC is facing a "very big crisis."

items.title: Russian secret services fabricating cases against civilians in occupied Kherson region to meet targets
items.teaser: Russian secret services in the temporarily occupied part of the Kherson region continue to fabricate charges against local residents to meet performance targets.

items.title: Russian sabotage attacks across Europe fall short of strategic goals, threats remain, report says
items.teaser: “It is highly likely that Germany and Poland will remain the most targeted states,” the report said.

items.title: Ukraine’s council of more than 360 arms makers courts Canadian auto parts plants hit by US tariffs. Their production lines could soon switch to drones
items.teaser: Besides drones, the Canadian plants could turn out drone interceptors, ground robots, and electronic warfare gear in the short term, their association's head says.

items.title: Russen griffen in der Nacht Eisenbahn- und Energieanlagen in neun Regionen an – Premierminister
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 27. November wurden Infrastruktur, Betriebe und Wohngebäude in neun Regionen angegriffen; ein Mensch wurde getötet und mindestens sechs weitere verletzt, teilte Ministerpräsident Serhij Korezkyj bei Telegram mit.

items.title: Russian strike on enterprise in Nizhyn kills two, injures four
items.teaser: Russian forces struck an enterprise in the city of Nizhyn, Chernihiv region. A man and a woman were killed in the attack, and four people were injured.

items.title: Starshield is back over Ukrainian-held land, but interceptors still can’t catch jet Shaheds over occupied land, Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: The president says Kyiv's questions about who capped SpaceX's military satellite service bounce between sides like ping pong

items.title: Russian strikes stop work at four Ukrainian producers in 15 days, from sunflower oil plants to Snow Panda toilet paper
items.teaser: Each halt costs Ukraine jobs, taxes, and exports, and Russia inflicts that loss without taking any ground.

items.title: Why Bulgaria, Czechia, Hungary, and Slovakia are complicating the latest EU push for a Ukraine loan
items.teaser: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico said the 45 billion loan is "not a loan in the real sense of the word. It is a pure grant, because the European Commission's documents explicitly state that the loan will be repaid by Ukraine only after Russia pays war reparations to Ukraine. We all know very well that nothing of the s

items.title: Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine tötete bereits 777 Kinder – Polizei
items.teaser: In der Ukraine sind während der großangelegten Invasion durch das russische Militär bereits 777 Kinder getötet worden.

items.title: Ukraine has US$80m for Grain from Ukraine programme – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine has over US$80 million for the Grain from Ukraine food programme, currently paused due to Russia's Black Sea blockade.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian oil facilities, defense industry plants, military airfields over past week
items.teaser: This week, the Ukrainian Defense Forces struck Russian oil facilities, plants involved in explosives production and other facilities supporting the war effort, as well as military airfields and aircraft.

items.title: Putin und sein Schattenkrieg: Forscher warnen vor Anschlag mit vielen Toten
items.teaser: Russlands Saboteure werden gefährlicher: Brand- und Sprengstoffanschläge haben sich in einem Jahr etwa verdoppelt. Jetzt schlagen Forscher Alarm.

items.title: Liberian Foreign Minister makes first-ever visit to Kyiv
items.teaser: Liberia’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, Sara Beysolow Nyanti, has arrived in Ukraine for her first official visit.

items.title: Two killed in Russian attack on business in Nizhyn: people may be trapped under rubble
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a business in the city of Nizhyn in Chernihiv Oblast on Friday 27 November, killing two people. Other people may be trapped under the rubble.

items.title: Russian air defense reportedly damaged homes in St. Petersburg as drones set a rubber plant tied to Iskander fuel on fire in Russia’s Tula Oblast
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff says the Tula Oblast rubber plant helps make solid fuel for Moscow's missiles, and Ukraine has hit it before. Overnight, a Ukrainian Telegram channel also reported strikes on targets in occupied Luhansk.

items.title: Sybiha erörtert Angriff auf russische Schiffe in Bengasi mit libyschem Außenminister
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Außenminister Andrij Sybiha erklärte dem libyschen Außenminister Taher Salem Al-Baour, dass der Angriff auf russische Schiffe im Hafen von Bengasi nicht gegen Libyen gerichtet gewesen sei und die Ukraine nicht die Absicht habe, den Krieg auf ein anderes Land auszuweiten.

items.title: Secretary General of the Council of Europe arrives in Kyiv
items.teaser: Secretary General of the Council of Europe Alain Berset has arrived in Kyiv for a visit during which he will meet with Ukraine’s leadership.

items.title: Ukraine halts electricity exports
items.teaser: Ukraine has halted electricity exports entirely as damage to its power transmission network has forced nuclear plants to cut generation and caused imports to surge.

items.title: Russian strikes hit railways and energy infrastructure in nine Ukrainian regions overnight – PM Koretskyi
items.teaser: Russian forces targeted infrastructure, industrial facilities and residential buildings in nine Ukrainian regions overnight on November 27, leaving one person dead and at least six others injured.

items.title: Zelenskyy sums up week's strikes on Russian oil refineries and military industry facilities – video
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has summed up the past week of successful Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian oil facilities, businesses within the military-industrial complex, and military airfields.

items.title: AfD co-leader calls for parts of Ukraine to be ceded to Russia and accuses Kyiv of attacking its own citizens
items.teaser: Alice Weidel says Kyiv should cede territories she describes as Russian-speaking to Moscow and claims Ukraine attacked its own population before Russia’s invasion.

items.title: IBSF demands that Ukrainian junior skeleton team remove Free Azov slogan from sleds
items.teaser: The International Bobsleigh and Skeleton Federation has demanded that Ukraine's junior skeleton team remove Free Azov slogans from their sleds.

items.title: Angriffe in Europa nehmen zu: Studie: Deutschland und Polen sind Hauptziele mutmaßlicher russischer Sabotage
items.teaser: Der Drohnenvorfall am Leipziger Flughafen ist schon lange kein Einzelfall mehr. Immer stärker geraten die europäischen Unterstützer der Ukraine ins Visier mutmaßlicher russischer Saboteure. Eine neue Studie verdeutlicht das Ausmaß der Angriffe in Europa.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine will defend Kyiv by any means as Russia seeks to drive people from cities
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia aims to force people to flee cities, including Kyiv, but assured that the Defense Forces would defend the capital by any means necessary. Without a capital, he stressed, there would be no country.

items.title: Kyiv printing house and publisher's office damaged by Russian attack for second time – photos
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Kyiv damaged the Konvi printing house and Mison publishing house office for the second time, destroying book stocks and damaging equipment.

items.title: Operation Hell-3: Ukrainian forces destroy Russian underground oil depot in occupied Luhansk Oblast – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces have destroyed a concealed oil depot in occupied Luhansk Oblast during Operation Peklo-3 (Hell-3). Russian forces had been using the depot to supply fuel to their units.

items.title: Explosionen in russischem Werk zur Herstellung von Treibstoffkomponenten für Raketen Iskander
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 27. November griffen Drohnen die Stadt Jefremow in der Region Tula in Russland an. Die Explosionen wurden in der Nähe eines dortigen Werks zur Herstellung von synthetischem Kautschuk registriert.

items.title: Zelensky says he holds no power over agencies pressuring Ukraine's anti-corruption institutions
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said he was "trying to support" NABU and SAPO, "but not to the extent of breaking the law, as they are independent institutions."

items.title: Ukraine releases figures on people missing due to war
items.teaser: More than 117,000 people, including military personnel, civilians, children and foreign nationals, are listed as missing due to the war.

items.title: Russian aggression claims 777 children's lives in Ukraine
items.teaser: A total of 777 children have been killed in Ukraine as a result of Russian military actions since the start of the full-scale invasion.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 6, injure 25 across Ukraine over past day, power outages across 6 oblasts

items.title: Westjordanland: Israelische Politiker sprechen von "jüdischem Terror"
